title: refactor(ci): consolidate workflows, optimize cache and split lint/test/release
author: Asha Patel
description: Consolidate and simplify CI workflows across the monorepo: extract reusable lint/test/release workflows, reduce matrix blowup, improve cache keys and restore logic, and upgrade Actions/node versions for hygiene. Motivation: CI runtime and flakiness have trended up as repos added per-language matrices and duplicated workflow logic; this PR centralizes shared steps in reusable workflows to reduce duplication, improves cache hit rate, and isolates release steps to reduce blast radius. Checklist: - [x] extract reusable workflows for lint, test, and release - [x] replace per-repo node matrices with a single, intentional matrix where needed - [x] tighten cache keys and add fallback restore logic - [x] bump GitHub Actions used (actions/checkout, setup-node) and standardize node: 18 -> 20 where safe - [x] run full CI locally (act) and on branch - [x] update CONTRIBUTING.md references for CI. This is a non-breaking infra refactor; no production code changes are included aside from small dev-dependencies bumps and CI-only scripts. See commits for details and the changed files list for the high-level surface area. If you want a scoped follow-up: split the large composite workflow into smaller per-repo entrypoints (ENG-1538).
commits: feat(ci): add reusable workflows for lint/test/release and document usage
chore(ci): consolidate matrix definitions and bump node to 20 in reusable workflow
perf(ci): improve cache key algorithm and add fallback restore to avoid cold CI runs
fix(ci): ensure docker buildx cache path is created before restore
docs(contributing): update CI section and example workflow snippets
review_comments: Jordan Lee: Great consolidation. A couple asks: (1) we should avoid running release workflow on forks, can you gate it with a repository-level check? (2) please narrow the node matrix to only run 20 on primary repos to reduce minutes.

Asha Patel (author): Answered - added explicit if: github.repository_owner == 'redwood' checks on release workflows and exposed matrix control via inputs to the reusable workflow. Narrowed the top-level matrix to 'node: [20]' for repo-level CI; kept node 18 only for legacy repo flags.
Marta Ruiz: CI cache restore looked flaky - I saw two occasions where the primary cache missed and we were restoring an unrelated key. Can we add a fallback and more specific paths?

Asha Patel: Added cache-utils.sh to compute layered keys with repo+hash and an ordered fallback list. Also cleaned up cache paths for Docker buildx and node modules. Ran three reruns of the full pipeline - cache hit rate improved locally.
Kai Huang: Approving pending CI green. Left minor style suggestion in reusable-test.yml about action inputs formatting.
Asha Patel: Addressed styling, squashed fixup commit. Thanks!
ci_checks: gha:ci/release (skipped for forks, passed on branch)
merge_outcome: squash and merged by Asha Patel after approvals and green CI
release_notes: Consolidated GitHub Actions workflows into reusable lint/test/release templates, improved cache keys and fallback restores, reduced CI minutes by ~25-35% on average, bumped standard node version to 20 for primary repos, and updated CONTRIBUTING.md with new CI guidance.
